svg.title: Laoshi Mains Trader - interpreted silhouette
svg.desc: Traders and Gunboats (2024), printed 132-133, PDF 133-134. Combined two-deck envelope follows wider upper accommodation/engineering deck: rounded narrow bridge prow, stepped forebody shoulders and broad rectangular aft hull. Lower cargo deck aligns aft at matching grid scale and is contained. Illustration corroborates rounded small nose and broad side machinery. Internal cargo airlocks and room borders excluded.
